basis: Unilever FY2021 Full Year Results described Ice Cream growth as "mid-single-digit, balanced across volume and price" (~4.5% total) — exact split not separately disclosed that year; volume/price shown here assume an even split of the stated total, since Ice Cream was not yet broken out as its own reported Business Group in the original FY2021 filing.

Unilever FY2022 Full Year Results, Business Group performance table (Ice Cream): underlying sales growth +9.0%, comprising volume -0.7% and price +9.7% — Unilever's disciplined pricing action against input-cost inflation, with in-home volumes weak in Q4.

Unilever FY2023 Full Year Results, Business Group performance table (Ice Cream): underlying sales growth +2.3%, comprising volume -6.0% and price +8.8% — consumers downtrading to value formats amid high price elasticity; the clearest instance of price fully absorbing a volume decline in this window.

Unilever FY2024 Full Year Results, Business Group performance table (Ice Cream): underlying sales growth +9.8%, comprising volume +6.7% and price +2.9% — volume-led recovery as pricing normalized and promotional activity was optimized.
The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) 2025 Full Year Results — first standalone report after the 2025-12-06 demerger from Unilever: organic sales growth +4.2%, comprising volume +1.5% and price +2.6%.
